scenes.setting: The Sun describes the half-destroyed temple and the unique statue standing in it, and old fox Alger milks the description for free before giving his advice on the expedition: absolutely do not go, because a true evil god's temple stays dangerous long after it falls
scenes.text_anchor: “The Fallen Creator is a true evil god.

scenes.setting: Klein notes sourly that Alger reached the same answer he would have, without paying for the description — then the Hanged Man coaches Derrick to fake the brink of losing control to dodge Lovia's compulsory expedition, 'you are doing so to save the City of Silver'
scenes.text_anchor: “You can always pretend to be on the brink of losing control.
